newsitem.title: USA: Mesaba July load factor down.
newsitem.headline: Mesaba July load factor down.

text.p: Mesaba Holdings Inc said Tuesday passenger load factor at its Mesaba airlines unit was 53.8 percent in July, down from 56.0 percent a year ago.
Revenue passenger miles were 56.5 million, compared to 41.0 million a year ago and available seat miles were 104.9 million, up from 73.2 million a year ago, the company said.
For the year through July, passenger load factor was 52.5 percent, up from 51.9 percent a year ago, the company said.
Revenue passenger miles were 312.5 million, up from 235.9 million a year ago, and available seat miles were 595.7 million, up from 454.8 million a year ago, the company said.
Mesaba Holdings shares rose 2/16 to 17-13/16 Tuesday.
